reapack.desc: ReaFL: FL Studio-style tools for REAPER

metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0\fswiss Helvetica;}}\f0\fs20{\b\fs28 ReaFL}\par FL Studio-style tools for REAPER's arrange view (native extension).\par\par{\b Setup:} none. Install, then restart REAPER. On first start ReaFL adds the shortcuts 1 (Default tool) and T (Mute tool) and opens a ReaFL toolbar. Keys you already use are left alone.\par\par{\b Tools:}\par\bullet Default (key 1): normal REAPER mouse behaviour.\par\bullet Mute (key T): left click an item toggles its mute (drag across items to mute/unmute them), right click deletes it. Clicks with Ctrl/Alt/Win and clicks on empty space behave normally.\par\par{\b Requirements:} REAPER 7 (tested on 7.84). No other extensions needed.\par Remove the shortcuts and toolbar with {\i ReaFL: Remove ReaFL shortcuts and toolbar}.\par Upgrading from 0.1.0 (Lua) is automatic: its shortcuts, toolbar and startup hook are converted on first start.\par}

version.author: Armaan
version.changelog: Initial release: tool modes with shortcuts (1 = Default, T = Mute) and a ReaFL toolbar. Mute tool: left click toggles an item's mute (selection untouched), right click deletes it.

version.author: Armaan
version.changelog:
Rewritten as a native REAPER extension (C++). No setup script any more.
- Install via ReaPack and restart: shortcuts 1 (Default tool) and T (Mute tool) and a ReaFL toolbar are added automatically on first start. Keys you already bound are left alone, and if you remove them they stay removed. - Mute tool now intercepts arrange-view clicks natively (no js_ReaScriptAPI needed, no mouse modifier changes): - left click toggles an item's mute without changing the selection - drag across items to mute/unmute them all (the first item decides), one undo point - right click deletes the item (undoable), no context menu - double-clicks do nothing extra; clicks with Ctrl/Alt/Win and clicks on empty space behave normally - New actions: "ReaFL: Remove ReaFL shortcuts and toolbar" and "ReaFL: Reinstall default shortcuts and toolbar". - Upgrading from 0.1.0 converts its shortcuts and toolbar to the new actions, removes the `__startup.lua` hook and clears its saved state.

version.author: Armaan
version.changelog: - In the Mute tool (and any future non-Default tool) REAPER's own left/right click and drag behaviour is now blocked everywhere in the arrange area, including empty space and below the last track: no marquee selection, deselecting, edit cursor moves, item moves or context menu. Clicks on items still mute / delete as before. - Right click on empty arrange space no longer opens the context menu in the Mute tool. - Ctrl / Alt / Win (Cmd / Option / Control) clicks in the arrange area are blocked too while a tool is active, so a tool never falls back to REAPER's mouse actions. They don't mute or delete either; use the Default tool (1) for REAPER's modifier clicks. - Still passed through: mouse wheel (scroll / zoom with any modifiers), middle button, hover, the keyboard (including the menu key context menu), and everything outside the arrange area (ruler, track panel, scrollbars, mixer, other windows). - A press that started in the Default tool finishes normally if you switch tools mid-drag, and a blocked press always releases the mouse capture on button-up (or when capture is lost), so drags can't get stuck.
